Draw step ribbons with interval bars and direction triangles

Source: R/seq_step_ribbon.R
seq_step_ribbon.Rd

Draws each row as a thin horizontal band over its genomic span at height y, with an optional vertical interval line from bar_lo to bar_hi at the span midpoint, a fixed-size triangle at the midpoint pointing up or down, and an optional label right of the span. Band thickness scales with the mapped thickness; triangle size is in mm, independent of span width and axis range. A row overlapping several windows is drawn in each, clipped to the window.

Usage

seq_step_ribbon(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  legend = NULL,
  legend_labels = NULL,
  legend_extra = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  legend_position = "canvas_margin",
  legend_side = "right",
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Optional GRanges. Falls back to the parent track's data.

mapping

Optional SeqMap. Fields: x0 (default start), x1 (default end), y (required), thickness (default 1), color (concrete colours, default "grey30"), alpha (default 1), label, bar_lo, bar_hi, pointing ("up", "down" or NA). y, bar_lo and bar_hi are in y axis units.

aesthetics

Optional SeqAes. half_height (axis units per thickness unit, default 0.006), tri_half_mm (1.1), tri_height_mm (1.9), line_width (1), label_cex (0.55), label_mm (1).

legend

NULL for automatic keys (one line key per thickness value present, labelled "thickness <k>"), FALSE for none, or a SeqLegendSpec or list of LegendKey used as given.

legend_labels

Named character vector relabelling the automatic keys, named by thickness value (e.g. c("1" = "one copy")).

legend_extra

List of LegendKey appended to the legend keys.

show_legend

Logical. FALSE suppresses the legend.

legend_position, legend_side

Placement of the legend. Default "canvas_margin", "right".

...

Additional arguments reserved for future use.

Value

A SeqStepRibbonR6 instance.

Examples

gr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges("chr1", IRanges::IRanges(c(1e5, 5e5), width = 2e5),
                             t = c(0.3, 0.6), k = c(1L, 3L))
seq_step_ribbon(gr, map(y = t, thickness = k, pointing = "up"))
